title: Otori Emu — Let's Think Together〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
The spinning teacups were so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, what do you wanna go on next?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-Slow down...
I think I need a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I'd like that as well...
My eyes are still spinning after riding those teacups...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? We're here to get away from everything for a bit, aren't we? I thought spinning our teacup as hard as possible would be fun for you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was fun in the beginning, but—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I spun it super duper hard too because I didn't want Rui to have all the fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's why my eyes are still spinning!
You two are to blame!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You two do seem like you could use a break. Why don't we look for a bench where we can all sit?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A break...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys!
I just thought of something great☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something great?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We should...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Taking a break while riding the Ferris wheel was a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See what I mean?! We're giving ourselves a chance to relax while going on an actual ride! It's almost too good to be true☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm starting to feel a little better already...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, it's been so long that I'd forgotten how good the view is from up here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right?! I really love the view too☆
That's why I wanted us to all go on it together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I mean, this Ferris wheel means so much to us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly does...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is where we decided to fill the Wonder Stage back up with smiles after we'd heard that it was about to be torn down...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Emu, this is where you told us about how you wanted to protect Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When you put it into perspective like that, it's somewhat moving that the four of us are here, looking down on the park again like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Lots of people are gathering by the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's right. Does that mean they're about to do a show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even though we're gone, the cast and audience are working together to keep it alive.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... Looks like it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys!
Wanna go over once we're off the Ferris wheel?
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, that was such a fun show☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. The way they incorporated the seating area into their performance was very clever.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't expecting the antagonists to be hiding among the audience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, and everyone seemed to love that!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Man, that was so much fun!
Another great show at the Wonder Stage...!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: And we got to see them do all those stunts right up close! I had trouble staying seated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sounds like they're genuinely enjoying seeing shows at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...! They're all smiling!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, they are...
Still, it felt strange watching a show here as members of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, since we only ever saw things from the stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly. And this place has given us so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It really has. It gave me friends to do shows with.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same here... I was reminded of just how much I love singing on stage... It gave me the inspiration to go after my dream again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... And we did so many shows here together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because of this stage and the others, I was able to keep believing in my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I wanna keep doing my best to fill Phoenix Wonderland with as many smiles as I can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm gonna start here...
And someday, I'll make the whole world smile!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna learn as much as I can to make that dream a reality!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Together! With you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep doing our best together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Now, ride what should we go on next?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, you guys! Come quick! We've got an emergency!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<S-So...
There's something we need to tell you...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah, uhh...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <A new area just appeared in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A new area?
